name: Decision Gate
description: Decides by your rules: picks a model when a new task starts, and judges before an automation or routine runs whether it needs to. A decision model (OpenAI Decisions or Jev) answers, using no Agent turn. Requires your own API key.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants new tasks to pick a model automatically, change model or reasoning effort by task content, or skip automation and routine runs with nothing to do. Also lists, adds, changes and deletes these rules.

list_rules.description: List all Decision Gate rules, the fallback model, the judge, and the models you can use (availableModels). Call this before adding or changing a rule.

save_rule.description: Add or change a rule (pass id to change). Shape: if question holds, use model (new task) or skip this run (before a run). Top to bottom, the first that holds wins. Returns the saved rule and when it applies; tell the user.

delete_rule.description: Delete a rule. Confirm with the user which rule first.

set_fallback_model.description: Set the fallback model, used when no condition holds or judging fails. Without one, this plugin’s model does not appear in the new task picker.
